title: feat(console): public-tier manifest dump (ADR-0080 generation)
body:
ADR-0080 — the **generation** half of the os-build manifest. Adds:
- `apps/console/manifest-dump.html` + `src/manifest-dump.tsx`: registers everything the console does, then exposes `window.__MANIFEST = manifestFromConfigs(ComponentRegistry.getPublicConfigs())`.
- `scripts/dump-public-manifest.mjs`: loads that page in headless chromium and writes `sdui.manifest.json`.

The registry is a browser app (plugin-map / plugin-charts pull browser-only deps), so it's enumerated in a real browser rather than headless node.

**Verified end-to-end** (manually, via the same browser path the script uses): the live registry produced **35 public blocks with full contracts** (e.g. `object-grid` → `objectName` required + `columns`/`filters`; `list-view` → `viewType` enum of grid/kanban/…/map; `object-form` → 19 typed props), and `@objectstack/sdui-parser`'s `compile()` against the dumped manifest catches missing-required (`objectName`), bad enum (`flex.direction`), and unknown components.

**Consumed by:** framework's `os build` JSX gate (objectstack-ai/framework #2446 reads `sdui.manifest.json`). The framework `build-console.sh` will run this extractor and copy the result into `@objectstack/console/dist/` (next PR + an `.objectui-sha` bump to a commit that includes this).
